useful_output: For each accepted local unicast frame, the destination guest receives the full original Ethernet frame in the buffers it posted, with correct virtio header/used length/ID/order. Source TX completion permits source reuse; destination storage remains owned until guest consumption/release.

owners.A: source guest/application/virtio TX mbuf until TX completion
owners.B: destination guest RX mbuf posted writable, unavailable to guest until used completion then owned by guest consumer
owners.backend: authorized mappings to both guests and optional host staging; not a new artificial security boundary
owners.FPGA: software represents these lifetimes inside one experiment owner/address domain; no hypervisor/VM isolation claim

real_producer: guest TX queue drained in main.c:1443-1457; payload produced by guest application, actual native capture not obtained
real_consumer: virtio_recv_pkts obtains original RX mbuf by used ID, strips virtio header length and returns full frame to guest application; no invented GPU/numerical consumer
positive_condition: Independent preposted A-TX and B-RX storage, valid source frame and advertised destination capacity: with unchanged guest address/cookie contract, delivering the frame requires materializing its bytes in B. Direct A→B CPU or DMA is fully legal.
adjacent_negative_condition: If original producer can legally generate directly in B storage, or actual exclusive page-loan/remap/shared-storage contract preserves all relevant addresses, neighbor bytes and lifetimes, avoid that copy; this candidate makes no necessity claim for that case.
ordinary_minimum: One direct A→B materialization per frame, CPU or single-DMA. Original two-stage A→host→B is not mandatory and does not define fair baseline.
natural_peer: Same source supports two vhost devices and independent channel mapping; reciprocal VM→VM deliveries are lawful peers. Actual simultaneous arrivals/backlog are null; do not fabricate them.

fpga_shared_path.claim: Finite projection only, physical 4-iDMA→mux→one translation port; one/same-owner engine is allowed ordinary control.

R0: pass for conditional independent-buffer delivery task; CPU/no-staging/direct copy remains legal
R1: conditional pass: legal DEFAULT DDR read/write exact span, all completion/cache constraints can be expressed with finite global DMA phases; named software glue required, not implemented
R2: source-backed symbolic bytes/lifetimes/capacity bounds and full costs provided; concrete next-run packet inputs/allocations/timing remain null until frozen ordinary baseline
R3: pass for explicitly limited FPGA projection; native deployment/common-IOMMU/performance not admitted
R4: one inactive ordinary baseline contract only; no avoidable translation residual measured
safety: conditional protocol obligation, not executed verification
novelty: No new mechanism proposed by this source admission; direct-copy optimization is ordinary and cannot be claimed as paper innovation.
performance: unknown; no speedup, CPU savings, isolation or native workload claim
